brief: A shadcn registry of manga-styled React components: rough.js ink outlines, screentone greys, one spot red, speech bubbles and sound effects. The logo should look drawn by the same pen as the components.
criteria: Success: reads as manga at a glance, is clearly drawn by hand, holds up as a 16 px favicon, and works on the site's light paper and dark ink themes.

concepts.name: Speech
concepts.idea: A hand-inked speech bubble that says one word: m.
rationale: Drawn with the same rough.js pen and Dela Gothic letters as the components
The speech bubble is manga's most recognisable device and mangacn's flagship component
Ink, paper and one spot red, taken straight from the theme tokens
A heavier small-size cut keeps the bubble and the m readable at 16 px

recommendation: Speech: one bubble, one letter, one red shadow, drawn by hand like everything else in mangacn.
